description: val5-order-02: several readers of one precedent, one layout per sheet, each sheet starting (bottom right) with a marker so that it does not depend on the sheet calculated before it. TwoReaders: B2 and C2 read the Sunday marker A2, the Monday marker A1 is above. TwoWriters: C2 (Sunday) and D2 (Monday) read the plain formula B2 after the Tuesday marker F2, and A1 above reads what is left. LoneFar: D2 (Sunday) is the only reader of B2, one cell away from it (C2 `=1` between), after the Tuesday marker F2; A1 reads what is left. ThreeReaders: as TwoReaders with a third reader D2. A reader joins WEEKNUM(2..7,99): 111111 after a Sunday marker (return_type 1), 222222 after a Monday marker (2), 122222 after a Tuesday marker (12) (dates.md "WEEKNUM's stale `return_type` state"; the decoding of probes/weeknum-stale-dependency). Raw values only; do not add cells or sheets: where each formula sits is the experiment. No expected values: the case is written to tell four candidate rules apart.
